description: Data contract for re-check and fail chase requests between Lender Portal and TCG Oversight Platform
lenderCanDo: Submit re-check requests for any control
Add lender notes visible to TCG
Dismiss requests (with mandatory reason for fail chases)
tcgCanDo: View all incoming requests across all lenders
Add TCG internal notes (NOT visible to lender)
Mark as In Progress / Completed / Referred
Record outcome: Confirmed / Updated / Referred to Manual Review
Update control result and score after re-check
tcgCannotDo: Dismiss requests on behalf of lender

autoChaseRules.dedupe: Only one open chase per dealerId + controlId at a time
autoChaseRules.escalationPath: If SLA breached → auto-escalate to Critical → TCG ops manager alerted
